# llm-output-diff

> Diff two LLM outputs by JSON field, number and claim: RFC 6901 paths for structured replies, aligned sentences with changed numbers for prose Python package `trysac-llm-output-diff`, import name `llm_output_diff`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
